name: CD Ladder (Certificate of Deposit)

yield.notes: FDIC insured. Rates locked at purchase. Laddering (3/6/12-month) maintains liquidity.

flags: FDIC insured up to $250k per institution

startup_checklist: Compare CD rates at bankrate.com (look for 'no-penalty CDs' for flexibility)
Split capital into 3 equal tranches: 3-month, 6-month, 12-month CDs
Open CDs and set maturity alerts
At each maturity, roll into new 12-month CD to extend the ladder
Track in spreadsheet: bank, amount, rate, maturity date
failure_modes: Need emergency access — penalty wipes gains
kill_criteria: CD maturity rate below HYSA equivalent — roll to HYSA instead
Institution shows financial instability (monitor FDIC ratings)
sources_note: Rates from Bankrate CD survey. Verify at time of purchase.
